subject: tr-def
title: TR.DEF.------CULT.SOLD.
description: Chart on book p. 59 (SD(SY)-37). TR-DEF (trans-definition) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From CULT-AF-BS: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From C-CONT: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From IF-ST-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From LK-IMP: MT-INFO (multi-information). From INDIV-TD: POST (postulation). From POST: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
